name: Legion of Dusk
description: The Legion of Dusk is the vampire army and military arm of Torrezon's church, formed under the order of Saint Elenda, whose conquistadors invaded Ixalan seeking the Immortal Sun.

bio.text: An undead army that crossed the Deoro and called itself the Legion of Dusk conquered Torrezon's kingdoms, and its victory sent the survivors of the Free Cities fleeing to the sea.

citations.text: "Torrezon", section "The conquest of Torrezon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Legion of Dusk", section "The conquest of Torrezon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Brazen Coalition", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: The Legion then sailed to Ixalan seeking glory, riches and the Immortal Sun, building forts and clashing with the Sun Empire, River Heralds and the pirates of the Brazen Coalition.

citations.text: Legion Conquistador (Ixalan, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
"Ixalan (continent)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
Swashbuckling (Ixalan, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Its conquistadors raced for Orazca, and Vona claimed the Immortal Sun for the Legion, though Saint Elenda lamented that the Church had turned her ritual into invasion.

citations.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Race". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: When the Sun was removed, the Legion retreated and the Sun Empire retook Orazca and pushed the Legion to the sea.

bio.text: In later years the Legion was captured by the Malamet and River Heralds and imprisoned by the Sun Empire, and its starving soldiers fed on servants and Oltec.

timeline.summary: Huatli and Inti return to Pachatupa with a captured Legion of Dusk sword after a final victory on the Sun Coast.
timeline.quote: Huatli and Inti were returning from the Sun Empire's last major campaign on the Sun Coast.

citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: A Legion of Dusk ship appears and Vraska recalls an earlier attack and the vampires' pursuit of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun was stolen from their monasteries

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: The crew boards the vampire ship and takes it by surprise.
timeline.quote: The vampires were caught completely off guard.

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk sails from Torrezon seeking glory, riches and the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The Legion of Dusk sailed from Torrezon in search of glory, riches, and the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: Legion Conquistador (Ixalan, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk builds up its fort walls just in time for pirates to burn them down.
timeline.quote: Wary of the ferocious dinosaurs, the Legion of Dusk built up the walls of their fort—just in time for the pirates to burn them down.

citation.text: Fiery Cannonade (Ixalan, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Legion's conquistadors surround a dinosaur only to find it has outflanked them.
timeline.quote: The conquistadors surrounded the dinosaur only to find that it had outflanked them.

citation.text: Spike-Tailed Ceratops (Ixalan, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk completes its conquest of Torrezon around 98 BD and the survivors of the Free Cities flee to the sea.
timeline.quote: When the Legion of Dusk completed their conquest of Torrezon around 98 BD

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brass declares the age of piracy over and forces a meeting of Sun Empire and Legion of Dusk factions to support a free pirate nation, declaring herself Governor.
timeline.quote: declared the age of piracy to be over

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "After the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk, Brazen Coalition, Kumena, Huatli, Angrath and Vraska race to Orazca for the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: In the race for Orazca, the planeswalker Angrath joined the fray, as well.

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Race". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire and River Heralds are met by the Legion of Dusk and the Brazen Coalition as all race for Orazca's secret.
timeline.quote: The dinosaur -riding warriors of the Sun Empire and the merfolk shamans of the rival River Heralds are met by the vampire conquistadores of the Legion of Dusk and the pirates of the Brazen Coalition .

citation.text: "Ixalan", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk crosses the seas seeking the Immortal Sun and the city of gold, building forts and clashing with the Sun Empire, River Heralds and pirates.
timeline.quote: crossed the seas in search of the Immortal Sun and the fabled city of gold

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire takes Orazca and pushes the Legion of Dusk to the sea; Fort Leor falls.
timeline.quote: After the Sun Empire took Orazca and pushed the Legion of Dusk to the sea

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "Locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The first vampire, Elenda of Garrano, ends Torrezon's three-century religious war; the Legion of Dusk conquers the continent and the Brazen Coalition forms.
timeline.quote: their inhabitants took to the sea and formed the Brazen Coalition

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire retakes Orazca and pushes the Legion of Dusk back, then launches the Dawn Fleet toward Torrezon.
timeline.quote: the Sun Empire pushed the Legion of Dusk back to the sea

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk, pirates and River Heralds depart; Apatzec Intli III claims the city and declares conquest of Torrezon.
timeline.quote: proclaimed a new age of conquest that would now target Torrezon

citation.text: "Orazca", section "The race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk conquers Torrezon; refugees refused harbor by the Sun Empire turn to raiding at sea.
timeline.quote: The Stormwreck Sea became a haven for outcasts when the Legion of Dusk conquered Torrezon around 98 BD .

citation.text: "Stormwreck Sea", section "Early Days". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The empire, besieged by Brazen Coalition raids and the Legion of Dusk, rises to fight off its enemies.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire was besieged by pirate raids by the Brazen Coalition and the advance of the Legion of Dusk

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Orazca retaken, the empire pushes the Legion of Dusk back to the sea and prepares an invasion of Torrezon.
timeline.quote: With Orazca retaken, the Sun Empire pushed the Legion of Dusk back to the sea

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Facing the New Phyrexian Invasion, the Sun Empire joins forces with the Legion of Dusk.
timeline.quote: the Sun Empire was forced to join forces with the Legion of Dusk to defend the plane.

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An undead army crosses the Deoro and calls itself the Legion of Dusk.
timeline.quote: They called themselves the Legion of Dusk .

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The conquest of Torrezon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Over four centuries Alta Torrezon swallows kingdoms and drives refugees toward the coast.
timeline.quote: For four more centuries, the armies of Alta Torrezon inexorably swallowed up kingdom after kingdom, expanding outward from their mountainous home, driving waves of refugees toward the free cities on the coast.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The conquest of Torrezon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion's first expedition to Ixalan ends in disaster with the second loss of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The Legion of Dusk's first expedition to Ixalan would end in disaster: a humiliation at Orazca, the second loss of the Immortal Sun, and Elenda's chastising of the Legion upon her return to Alta Torrezon.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "First expedition to Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A storm and a Legion of Dusk ship converge as the ship nears Ixalan, and Vraska orders abandon ship.
timeline.quote: Jace saw the Legion of Dusk ship coasting atop the water.

citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli threatens Elenda, refusing to let the Legion of Dusk take the city.
timeline.quote: I refuse to allow the Legion of Dusk to take the city.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda laments that the Church turned her ritual into invasion.
timeline.quote: I left the Church with the knowledge of the ritual to take on my burden

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda vows to teach the Legion of Dusk what they forgot and vanishes through a dark slice in the air.
timeline.quote: She stepped forward, past Huatli and Angrath, and vanished into a dark slice in the air.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Legion explorers reach Orazca and ransack tombs and temples hunting for the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Once they reached Orazca, the Legion's explorers ransacked tombs and temples, hunting for the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: Dusk Legion Zealot (Rivals of Ixalan, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In the galleon's wreckage the conquistadors swear vows of revenge.
timeline.quote: In its wreckage, they swore vows of revenge.

citation.text: Forsaken Sanctuary (Rivals of Ixalan, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elenda meets Angrath and Huatli and is appalled that the Legion of Dusk became cruel invaders.
timeline.quote: was appalled to hear that the Legion of Dusk had become cruel invaders in her absence

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Huatli concludes the Legion of Dusk has taken control of the Immortal Sun and the city.
timeline.quote: the Legion of Dusk had taken control of the Immortal Sun

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli and Tishana burst into the Sun chamber and Vona claims the Immortal Sun for the Legion of Dusk.
timeline.quote: I am Vona, Butcher of Magan, and the Immortal Sun belongs to the Legion of Dusk!

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor gifts the Immortal Sun to a monastery and then to the Sun Empire, reclaiming it each time.
timeline.quote: He gifted the Immortal Sun to a monastery that would later give rise to the Legion of Dusk

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Apatzec reveals he is weeks away from invading Fort Adanto.
timeline.quote: We are weeks away from invading Fort Adanto in the south.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vona returns and claims Orazca for the Legion of Dusk.
timeline.quote: Orazca had been claimed for the Legion of Dusk!

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien learns that Luneau uses blood as currency and treats humans as livestock for its Legion of Dusk rulers.
timeline.quote: Vivien learned that the city relied on blood as currency

citation.text: "Luneau", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vivien releases the Royal Menagerie's beasts, which overrun the city and kill or scatter the vampire rulers while humans rejoice.
timeline.quote: The vampire rulers were killed or scattered as the wild reclaimed Luneau City.

citation.text: "Luneau", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A vast undead army calling itself the Legion of Dusk marches from Alta Torrezon on a campaign of conquest.
timeline.quote: They called themselves the Legion of Dusk .

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The conquest of Torrezon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The last independent city-states of the southern coast fall, sending refugees fleeing across the sea.
timeline.quote: the few remaining independent city-states on the continent's southern coast would fall to the Legion's armies

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The conquest of Torrezon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire repels the Legion's attempted conquest.
timeline.quote: The Legion's attempted conquest of the continent was repelled by the Sun Empire.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Age of Ever-Flowing Blood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire, pirates and the Legion of Dusk unite and Zacama fells Etali, saving Ixalan from the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Etali was finally felled by Zacama after injuring Zetalpa

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz escapes on a Dusk Legion ship bound for Torrezon to find Vona.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz escaped, securing passage to Torrezon on a Dusk Legion ship.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The crisis of faith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Caparocti tells Wayta he is sure war with the Dusk Legion is coming and that the colonizers must be eliminated.
timeline.quote: The colonizers must be eliminated, or they will never stop trying to rule us.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Two dozen catlike Malamet warriors surround the Legion.

citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Okinec Ahau sentences the Legion to be given to the sand.

citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: River Heralds surround and capture the Legion in the water.
timeline.quote: River Heralds, dozens, all armed with their strange jade weapons and elemental magics.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire party reaches the top of the building facing the golden door and meets the vampires, provoking hostility.
timeline.quote: The other warriors mirrored her disgust, some reaching for weapons.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Inti and Caparocti call for the vampires to be imprisoned or killed, and Pashona threatens to return them to the sea.
timeline.quote: These invaders should be imprisoned

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia smells blood as the starving Legion soldiers feed on their own servants.
timeline.quote: When the scent of blood reached her, Amalia feared the worst.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Clavileño and the soldiers hunt and feed on Oltec in the fog.

citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.quote: I require more sacrifices. You will bring them to me.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.quote: The vampire abominations flew toward the Oltec force.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta wounds a vampire-bat in air combat.
timeline.quote: Her blade tore a deep gash in her enemy's wing, and with a scream, he spun toward the earth.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.quote: One of them struck a swollen fungal sac with its blade, releasing a cloud of spores that settled on its skin like flies.
